column1: # alias<TAB>owner/repo. Consulted by lanes-edit.sh when an object key omits
# the owner, and when the spelling a lane typed is not the canonical GitHub
# nameWithOwner. Lookup is CASE-INSENSITIVE, so one row covers `OpsxFactory`,
# `opsXfactory` and `opsxfactory` — all three of which the register uses.
# An alias that is NOT here is REFUSED, with the hint to spell owner/repo. That
# is deliberate: guessing is how `opensoft/codexFactory` became a fifth
# spelling of one repository. Spellings the register uses but that could not be
# resolved to a repository are therefore LEFT OUT rather than guessed at —
# `MedxFactory`, `MedxGlass`, and the bare `InkRouter` and `IRSS`, which are
# ambiguous between the `opensoft` org and the separate `InkRouter` org.
# Seeded 2026-09-11 from the register's own LANDING lines
# and from the estate-wide spelling survey, each resolved against GitHub with
# `gh repo view <r> --json nameWithOwner`. All four codexFactory spellings map
# to `codeXfactory/codexFactory`: the repository moved org while the register
# was live, and that is the redirect GitHub itself answers with today.
# Add a row when a new repo first appears in a LANDING line. Keep it sorted.
